question: When x is subtracted from each of 43, 38, 11 and 10, then the numbers so obtained in this order are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (11x + 3) and (9x - 2) ?
solution:
**Given:**

When x is subtracted from each of 43, 38, 11 and 10, then the numbers so obtained in this order are in proportion.

**Concept used:**

If a, b, c, and d are in proportion,

Then a/b = c/d

Mean proportion of two numbers a and b is = √(a × b)

**Calculation:**

(43 - x)/(38 - x) = (11 - x)(10 - x)

⇒ (43 - x)(10 - x) = (11 - x)(38 - x)

⇒ 430 - 43x - 10x + x² = 418 - 11x - 38x + x²

⇒ 430 - 53x = 418 - 49x

⇒ 4x = 430 - 418 = 12

⇒ x = 12/4 = 3

Now, mean proportional between (11x + 3) and (9x - 2) is

⇒ √(11x + 3)(9x - 2) 

⇒ √(33 + 3)(27 - 2) = √(36 × 25)

⇒ 30

**∴ The mean proportional between (11x + 3) and (9x - 2) is 30.**
